title: John Mack's abduction cases were done by humans

tellings.quote: but what they didn't know every one of those cases that were being funneled to him Yeah. were all done by humans.

plain: In the 1990s John Mack, a Harvard figure who studied people who said aliens had abducted them, was sent a stream of cases, and every one of them was really "done by humans." The UFO researcher Steven Greer says this without naming a source, and he also brings up Budd Hopkins, another abduction researcher. If true, it would mean someone staged these abductions and fed them to the researchers on purpose.
